subject: POC handoff — final gating checklist and cutover windows
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@nimblecare.co>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — NimbleCare POC gating

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NimbleCare is keen to move the POC to a short pilot. Before we get started our security and infra teams asked for a concise gating checklist so they can lock dates on their side. At minimum they need:

- Redwood org setup (SAML + infra contacts)
- API key issuance and a non-prod test token
- IP allowlist details (CIDR ranges)
- VPC peering requirements and expected maintenance windows

Can you propose a tight timeline for these items so we can confirm with our CTO? We are aiming to begin validation the week of Nov 10.

Also attaching our internal compliance questionnaire (see link).

Samir
Head of Platform, NimbleCare
[Attachment referenced: internal-compliance-q.pdf]
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimblecare.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-27T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — NimbleCare POC gating

Samir — appreciate the clear list. I put together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a proposed cutover window. High level:

1) Org + SAML: we can spawn your Redwood org and seed SSO metadata within 3 business days after your IdP config is shared. Owner: Marissa.
2) API keys / test token: we will create a scoped test API key (non-prod) the same day org is ready. Owner: Dylan.
3) IP allowlist: we can accept a list of /24 or /16 CIDRs; we’ll provide our egress IPs and a suggested ingress set. Owner: Naomi.
4) VPC peering: standard peering requires your VPC CIDR and a technical contact; typical turnaround 5–7 business days with ops calendar alignment. Owner: Priyom.

Proposed timeline (subject to your signoff):
- 10/28: Share IdP metadata + NimbleCare peering CIDR and test subnet
- 10/30: Redwood org created + test key issued
- 11/03: IP allowlist finalized & egress IPs confirmed
- 11/07–11/09: VPC peering window (schedule with you)
- Week of 11/10: Begin validation tests

I attached MAP-v1.xlsx and an interop diagram. If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min cutover planning call.

Attachments:
[Attachment: MAP-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: interop-diagram.png (image/png)]

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding NimbleCare's ask and the MAP I drafted. Quick owners/asks below:

- Marissa: please create the Redwood org once Samir confirms IdP metadata; flag any SAML edge cases.
- Naomi: confirm the public egress IPs and draft the ingress recommendation (we may need to accept /16s if their infra team requests).
- Priyom: prepare peering checklist (required fields: VPC CIDR, peer ASN if needed, contact for BGP if applicable) and estimate calendar slots for early Nov.

I’ll hold the external cutover call invite until we have the CIDR and IdP. Please respond with availability for a 20–30 min sync later today.

Thanks — D.

All — quick check-in. I can create the org once Samir sends IdP metadata. Two notes:

1) We should offer them an interim admin account in case SAML takes longer; low-risk, short-lived (expires 7 days) local admin to avoid hold ups.
2) For peering: what is our preferred minimal CIDR? I recommend we ask for a /24 for the test subnet and request their public peering CIDRs as /16 or /24 depending on their network. Priyom — can you confirm if we need BGP details for this customer?

I’m available for a 20-min sync at 3:30 PM PT.

Marissa Cole

From: Samir Patel <samir@nimblecare.co>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: IT Ops <itops@nimblecare.co>
Date: 2025-10-28T08:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — NimbleCare POC gating

Thanks — quick answers from our infra team:

- IdP metadata will be sent by EOD 10/27 (we had a small delay).
- Test subnet: nimble-test-01 -> 10.40.128.0/24 (we can carve a /24)
- Public peering CIDRs: 34.210.0.0/16, 44.55.66.0/24 (primary egress)
- We prefer to avoid BGP for this short pilot; static peering is fine.

Request: could you issue a scoped test API key with token-level logging disabled for the initial runs? Also, what are your maintenance windows for the week of 11/07 — we want to avoid scheduled infra changes during our acceptance tests.

Proposed cutover window: 11/07 02:00–06:00 PT (we can be flexible if Redwood needs different hours).

Samir

Samir — perfect, thanks for the details. Confirming next steps: 

- 10/28 EOD: We will provision the Redwood org and provide either SAML seed or a temporary admin. Owner: Marissa.
- 10/30: Scoped non-prod test key created (scoped: data-read, rate-limited). We'll disable token-level debug logging by default and enable only if you request it. Owner: Dylan.
- 11/03: IP allowlist finalized. Naomi will publish our egress IPs and accept the CIDRs you shared.
- 11/07 02:00–06:00 PT: Tentative VPC peering activation window. Priyom to coordinate a 30-min pre-check with your itops lead.

I attached the signed proposal and Docusign link for the initial pilot term. Can you confirm the 11/07 window today so I can lock the calendar and book the ops slot?

Next meeting: 30-min cutover planning (suggested 10/30 11:00 AM PT) — I'll send the invite once you confirm the window.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
